objective: Test whether deterministic one-ticket fallback routing can preserve the pooled/fold economics seen in WIDE-focused development while reducing meeting-level full-loss tails without simultaneous double-staking. Use WIDE as the primary market and exactly one preregistered complementary market only when no WIDE ticket passes the frozen filters. Use only already-exposed V1-V7 evidence. Development-only; cannot validate profitability.

scientific_context.design_change: V6 showed that adding more WIDE tickets preserved pooled economics but left a severe full-loss tail; V7 simultaneous WIDE+companion coverage reduced the tail but damaged pooled and fold economics. V8 changes the stake-routing mechanism: choose at most one ticket per race, preferring WIDE when it passes; otherwise route to one complementary market. V5/V6/V7 stability gates are unchanged.

development_pool.basis: Exact same 25 already-exposed economics meetings used by V5/V6/V7; no new or protected evidence.

cross_meeting_folds.construction: Same fixed five folds as V5/V6/V7 for comparability; no outcome-conditioned reassignment.

fallback_policy_family.routing_rule: For each configuration and race, independently filter WIDE and the configured fallback market using identical conservative NL2/B1a criteria. If any WIDE ticket is eligible, select the best WIDE ticket. Otherwise, if any fallback ticket is eligible, select the best fallback ticket. Otherwise abstain. Never select more than one ticket per race.
fallback_policy_family.design_reason: This isolates whether cross-market coverage can be obtained by substitution rather than additive stake. It directly addresses the V6/V7 tradeoff without relaxing any stability gate or retuning probability models.

development_outcome_rules.eligible_policy_count_zero: NO_DEVELOPMENT_ELIGIBLE_POLICY; stop before any fresh target access.
development_outcome_rules.eligible_policy_count_positive: Freeze exactly one development-only winner. Do not select or access a fresh holdout in this run. A separate future preregistration is required.

forbidden_rescue_actions: Do not relax V5/V6/V7 stability gates to force a winner.
No simultaneous primary+fallback tickets in the same race.
No fallback market outside the three preregistered markets.
No outcome-conditioned meeting deletion or fold reassignment.
No fresh validation target access in V8.
scientific_claim_boundary: Any V8 winner is exposed-development-only. It is not validated, deployable, live-ready, or evidence of future profitability.
